implementation_notes: The supplier publishes an API surface (often an OpenAPI spec plus a NuGet client SDK) and negotiates versioning with consumers. Use consumer-driven contract tests (Pact) so a break fails the supplier's build, which is what turns negotiation into an enforceable rule.
idiom_name: published contract + Pact consumer-driven contract tests
pitfalls: Negotiating a deprecation policy the CI never enforces
Versioning the URL but not the payload schema, so breaks still land on customers
